title: Designing Open Spaces in High-rise Buildings: A Study Based on Neuroesthetics

findings.consequent: Positive psychological effects, perceived restoration value, reduced stress
findings.quote: it was proved by many scholars that exposure to natural environment could produce positive psychological effects on people... natural landscape significantly improved the perceived restoration value (Table 1).

findings.antecedent: Open indoor environment (compared to enclosed space)
findings.consequent: Perceived as more natural and beautiful, more popular, activation of temporal lobe structures associated with perceived visual motion
findings.quote: scholars found that open indoor environment was considered more natural and beautiful as well as more popular than enclosed space as the open interior space activates the temporal lobe structures associated with perceived visual motion.

findings.consequent: Increased preference, positive emotion, activation of precuneus and middle frontal gyrus (spatial attention and exploration)
findings.quote: people preferred to high ceiling as high ceiling can activate precuneus and middle frontal gyrus. These structures were mainly used for spatial attention and exploration, suggesting that this positive emotion was directly related to people's desire to move in space.

findings.antecedent: Viewing water landscape and mountain landscape (compared to forest and urban landscapes)
findings.consequent: Better attention restoration ability, reduced activation of visual brain regions, activation of attention system
findings.quote: water landscape and mountain landscape had a better attention restoration ability compared with forest landscape and urban landscape. In terms of neural responses, viewing urban landscapes requires greater visual attention to activate cuneus than water landscape and mountain landscapes, suggesting that viewing water landscape and mountain landscape after an urban landscape may significantly reduce the activation of visual brain regions and activate the rest of the attention system.

findings.antecedent: Integration of fractal patterns into built environment
findings.consequent: Evokes a sense of nature, higher preference, higher coding efficiency and information transmission rates in neurons (primary visual cortex)
findings.quote: fractals would evoke a sense of nature and be more popular than non-fractal designs... fractals had a higher priority in the responses of neurons in the primary visual cortex... The fractal visual signal has better coding efficiency and transmission efficiency in processing.
